from pathlib import Path

base=Path("/home/mekashirskiy/projection-transport-steering/artifacts/selection/irc_baseline_v3")

records=[json.loads(line) for line in (base/"dispatch.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
rows=[]
for record,item in zip(records,d["launches"],strict=True):
    info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["sudo","-n","docker","inspect",record["container_id"]],text=True))[0]
    argv=item["command"]
    image_at=argv.index(c["runtime_identity"]["image"])
    assert info["Image"]==c["runtime_identity"]["image"]
    assert info["Config"]["Entrypoint"]==["timeout"] and info["Config"]["Cmd"]==argv[image_at+1:]
    assert info["Config"]["User"]=="11027:11027" and info["Config"]["WorkingDir"]=="/work"
    assert info["HostConfig"]["NetworkMode"]=="none"
    assert info["HostConfig"]["DeviceRequests"][0]["DeviceIDs"]==[str(item["gpu"])]
    for target in ("/work","/model","/ptsenv","/overlay"):
        mount=next(m for m in info["Mounts"] if m["Destination"]==target)
        assert not mount["RW"]
    assert not any(m["Destination"]=="/warm" for m in info["Mounts"])
    env=info["Config"]["Env"]
    for index,value in enumerate(argv):
        if value=="--env":
            assert argv[index+1] in env
    raw=subprocess.run(["sudo","-n","docker","logs",record["container_id"]],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
    events=[]
    for line in raw.stdout.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("{"):
            events.append(json.loads(line))
    progress=[e for e in events if e.get("event") in ("selection_chunk","fit_update","baseline_terminal")]
    rows.append({"index":record["index"],"container_id":record["container_id"],"state":info["State"],"restarts":info["RestartCount"],"actual_argv_mounts_env_match":True,"last_progress_event":progress[-1] if progress else None,"last_fit_event":next((e for e in reversed(events) if e.get("event")=="fit_update"),None),"selection_completed":max([e["completed"] for e in events if e.get("event")=="selection_chunk" and e.get("condition")=="selection"],default=0),"fit_bytes":(base/f"candidate_{record['index']:02d}"/"run"/"fit.jsonl").stat().st_size if (base/f"candidate_{record['index']:02d}"/"run"/"fit.jsonl").exists() else None,"adapter_bytes":(base/f"candidate_{record['index']:02d}"/"run"/"adapter.pt").stat().st_size if (base/f"candidate_{record['index']:02d}"/"run"/"adapter.pt").exists() else None})
gpu=subprocess.check_output(["nvidia-smi","--query-gpu=index,memory.used,utilization.gpu","--format=csv,noheader,nounits"],text=True).strip()
print(json.dumps({"timestamp":datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),"workers":rows,"gpu_snapshot":gpu,"snapshot_is_average_utilization":False,"scientific_comparison_complete":False}),flush=True)
